title: Five incidents explain more than one average
method: Synthetic durations sum to 200 minutes; mean=200/5=40; median=20. Timing starts at customer impact and ends at verified recovery. Small illustrative sample, not a customer benchmark.
alt: Five incidents explain more than one average: Incident A 10 minutes, Incident B 15 minutes, Incident C 20 minutes, Incident D 25 minutes, Incident E 130 minutes. Synthetic example.
